name: Aegis Session Sweeper
description: Opt-in selective purger for stale site browsing data (older than N days of inactivity), never for open tabs or allow-listed domains.
notes: Permissions (complete list, all used): browsingData = per-origin purge via browser.browsingData.remove with NO 'since' cutoff (a cutoff deletes data NEWER than a timestamp, the opposite of a stale purge, and the API cannot enumerate per-origin ages). storage = config, opt-in flag, and the last-interaction ledger (Privacy Class P1). alarms = daily scheduled sweep. history = browser.history.onVisited records last-interaction per origin. tabs = browser.tabs.query reads open-tab URLs ONLY to guarantee data for sites with an open tab is never deleted; tab URLs are never recorded or transmitted. First use is opt-in with a preview of what would be deleted (PREVIEW_SWEEP). No host permissions. No network access.
